mapper.select: SELECT * FROM skill_repositories ORDER BY updated_at DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM skill_repositories WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_repositories SET name = #{name}, repo_url = #{repoUrl}, branch_name = #{branch}, auth_type = #{authType}, access_token = #{accessToken}, token_preview = #{tokenPreview}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE skill_repositories SET last_commit_sha = #{lastCommitSha}, last_pull_status = #{lastPullStatus}, last_pull_message = #{lastPullMessage}, last_pulled_at = #{lastPulledAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT d.*, r.name AS repository_name FROM skill_definitions d JOIN skill_repositories r ON r.id = d.repository_id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC, d.skill_name ASC
SELECT d.*, r.name AS repository_name FROM skill_definitions d JOIN skill_repositories r ON r.id = d.repository_id WHERE d.repository_id = #{repositoryId} ORDER BY d.relative_path ASC
SELECT d.*, r.name AS repository_name FROM skill_definitions d JOIN skill_repositories r ON r.id = d.repository_id WHERE d.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO skill_definitions ( id, repository_id, skill_name, original_name, relative_path, description, content_hash, warnings, syncable, last_commit_sha, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
( #{definition.id}, #{definition.repositoryId}, #{definition.skillName}, #{definition.originalName}, #{definition.relativePath}, #{definition.description}, #{definition.contentHash}, #{definition.warnings}, #{definition.syncable}, #{definition.lastCommitSha}, #{definition.createdAt}, #{definition.updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM skill_instance_syncs ORDER BY updated_at DESC, instance_id ASC, skill_name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_instance_syncs ( instance_id, skill_name, skill_id, repository_id, source_commit_sha, status, message, synced_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{instanceId}, #{skillName}, #{skillId}, #{repositoryId}, #{sourceCommitSha}, #{status}, #{message}, #{syncedAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE skill_id = VALUES(skill_id), repository_id = VALUES(repository_id), source_commit_sha = VALUES(source_commit_sha), status = VALUES(status), message = VALUES(message), synced_at = VALUES(synced_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
